title: Unpushed-delete guard fails open when the task record exists only in the lane commit
body: `git worktree remove --force <lane>` on a lane whose unpushed Ticket commit holds the only copy of its task record is allowed: readFileSync of <main>/tasks/<id>.json throws ENOENT and the catch allows (src/hook/unpushed-delete.ts:135-147).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d5-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/hook/unpushed-delete.ts, test/hook/unpushed-delete.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d5-unpushed-delete-lane-task.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
